video_summary.overall_goal: The user appears to inspect Wi-Fi network information across different analyzer views, open details for the current network, and export/share the access point information.
video_summary.description: The recording shows the WiFiAnalyzer app starting on the Access Points screen, switching between Channel Rating, Channel Graph, and Time Graph views, opening a Wi-Fi network detail dialog, opening the navigation drawer, and launching the Android sharing sheet for exported access point text.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: The Access Points screen is visible with current Wi-Fi connection information and a list of nearby access points.
steps.system_response: The Access Points screen remains visible.
steps.visual_feedback: The Access Points tab is highlighted.
steps.intent_task: View available Wi-Fi access points and current connection details.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: The app switches to a channel rating table showing Wi-Fi channel ratings and access point counts.
steps.navigation_change: Access Points screen changes to Channel Rating screen
steps.visual_feedback: The Channel Rating tab becomes highlighted.
steps.intent_task: Check recommended Wi-Fi channels and channel quality.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: The app switches to a graph showing Wi-Fi signal strength across Wi-Fi channels.
steps.navigation_change: Channel Rating screen changes to Channel Graph screen
steps.visual_feedback: The Channel Graph tab becomes highlighted and a blue channel graph is displayed.
steps.intent_task: View the Wi-Fi signal distribution across channels.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: The app switches to a time graph view with a signal strength grid and a visible network label.
steps.navigation_change: Channel Graph screen changes to Time Graph screen
steps.visual_feedback: The Time Graph tab becomes highlighted.
steps.intent_task: View Wi-Fi signal changes over time.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: The app returns to the Channel Graph screen with the Wi-Fi signal graph visible.
steps.system_response: The Channel Graph screen opens again.
steps.navigation_change: Time Graph screen changes to Channel Graph screen
steps.visual_feedback: The Channel Graph tab becomes highlighted.
steps.intent_task: Return to the channel graph view for the current Wi-Fi network.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: A dialog opens over the Channel Graph screen showing detailed information for the AndroidWifi network.
steps.visual_feedback: The background is dimmed and the details dialog is shown.
steps.intent_task: Inspect detailed technical information for the selected Wi-Fi network.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: The Channel Graph screen is visible again after the network details dialog closes.
steps.intent_task: Close the network details dialog and return to the graph.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: The side navigation drawer opens over the Channel Graph screen.
steps.visual_feedback: The drawer appears from the left and the rest of the screen is dimmed.
steps.intent_task: Open the app menu to access additional options.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: The Android sharing sheet opens with exported access point text and sharing app options.
visible_ui_elements: No recommended people to share with
steps.system_response: The Android sharing sheet opens with generated sharing text.
steps.visual_feedback: A bottom share panel appears over the dimmed app screen.
steps.intent_task: Export or share the Wi-Fi access point information.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: The app returns to the Channel Graph screen, and a floating sharing/text preview control remains near the bottom.
steps.system_response: The sharing sheet closes and the Channel Graph screen becomes visible again.
steps.visual_feedback: A floating exported text preview with share and copy controls is visible.
steps.intent_task: Return to the app after opening the share/export interface.

overall_flow: Open WiFiAnalyzer on the Access Points screen.
Switch to Channel Rating to view recommended channels.
Switch to Channel Graph to view signal strength by channel.
Switch to Time Graph to view signal strength over time.
Open and close details for the AndroidWifi network.
Use Export to open the Android sharing sheet.
Close the sharing sheet and return to the graph.
human_readable_step_summary: Step 1: The app opens on the Access Points screen and shows the current Wi-Fi connection and nearby access points.
Step 2: The user taps Channel Rating to see Wi-Fi channel ratings.
Step 3: The user taps Channel Graph to view the Wi-Fi signal on a channel graph.
Step 4: The user taps Time Graph to view Wi-Fi signal information over time.
Step 5: The user taps Channel Graph again to return to the channel graph view.
Step 6: The user taps the Wi-Fi network graph or item to open detailed information about the AndroidWifi network.
Step 7: The user taps OK to close the network details dialog.
Step 8: The user taps the menu icon to open the app navigation drawer.
Step 9: The user taps Export to open the Android sharing sheet with access point text.
Step 10: The sharing sheet closes and the user returns to the Channel Graph screen.
